title: Project Catbus
description: All aboard the Cat Bus! An eclectic, Aeronautics-themed modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1.
body:
# All aboard the Catbus!

### Description
Welcome to Project Catbus: a modpack primarily centred around Create & Create: Aeronautics, including several other Create addons and a curated selection of other mods (more on that below). The primary focus is tech, but there's also magic, plenty of decorative blocks, and a few optimisation bits etc. to-boot.

**Project Catbus is primarily intended for use on a private server - but you're welcome to join the fun!**

---

### Also Includes...
As well as the above mods, Project Catbus also contains a couple extra bells and whistles...
- A custom KubeJS script to balance the Sable weights of blocks from various mods.
- A selection of Resource Packs, enabled by default: [Re-Applied](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/re-applied), [Computercraft: Re-Created](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/computer-craft-recreated), and [Create Style Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/create-sophisticated-backpacks/versions).
